scenes.label: KYOTO KISSATEN
scenes.head: 3 old coffee houses in Kyoto
scenes.body: Older than your grandparents. Still pouring.

scenes.label: 01  SMART COFFEE
scenes.head: Hotcakes in a coffee house from 1932
scenes.body: On Teramachi, near Sanjo. Expect a line on weekends.

scenes.label: 02  ROKUYOSHA
scenes.head: Coffee and a homemade donut, downstairs
scenes.body: A post-war coffee house on Kawaramachi-Sanjo. The basement is closed on Wednesdays.

scenes.label: 03  FRANCOIS
scenes.head: A 1934 coffee house that is a cultural property
scenes.body: Arches and red velvet, like a ship's lounge. Near Shijo, by the Takase River.

scenes.label: BEFORE YOU GO
scenes.head: Go on a weekday morning.
scenes.body: Weekends bring lines. Hours change, so check each shop before you go.
